# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 50 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Seth Writes the Tablets

---

**1** Seth wrote on tablets of stone and tablets of clay all the words of his father and mother and all their deeds.

**2** He wrote of the creation of the world and the fall in paradise, and of Adam and Eve's penance, and of the hope of the resurrection.

**3** He kept these tablets in a safe place, saying: 'These will be found in the last days.'

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
